title: Official Xenium XOA v4 tiny-output real-instrument artifact sensitivity study
claim_target: BioNexus artifact diagnostics execute on authentic Xenium XOA bytes and respond in the expected direction to deterministic manufactured confounders.

locked_endpoints.segmentation_leakage: mean nearest-neighbor cosine similarity must increase after deterministic 20% neighbor mixing
locked_endpoints.cell_size_bias: Spearman correlation between cell area and total counts must increase by at least 0.20 after deterministic area scaling
locked_endpoints.transcript_density_bias: Spearman correlation between local density and total counts must increase by at least 0.20 after deterministic density scaling
locked_endpoints.coordinate_permutation: coordinate permutation must change the coordinate SHA-256 while preserving the expression matrix SHA-256
locked_endpoints.fov_confounding: manufactured condition equal to observed FOV must produce Cramer's V of 1.0 when at least two FOVs are present

governance.reason: The vendor documents the tiny dataset as format-testing material not intended for biological conclusions.
